prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. ONE DESIGN BOARD with exactly3 independent existing DooKnow owner-menu specimens, clearly external labels A创建与导入 / B笔记操作 / C账户菜单 under DESIGN BOARD. Do not make them appear simultaneously open in one app screen. PILOT STYLE ONLY: flat white/light-gray, #272b3a/#657084, thin#e6e9f1, blue#4566c6/pale#edf1ff, compact readable13px-scale menu rows and8px corners. No full owner rail/tree/page or new features. A actual matching create dropdown screenshot is control/content authority; B/C are source-derived from actual templates.
A: small truthful “新建 | ˅” split-button cue and its open create/import dropdown below right chevron. Exactly source6 icon rows in order 新建笔记, 新建白板, 新建脑图, 新建流程图, 新建文件夹, 导入 Markdown. Tree loaded=true, creation enabled, no extra command.
B: actual NOTE context menu, header示例记录.md, source text-only rows in order 打开, 收藏, 重命名或移动, 创建副本, 下载 Markdown, 复制路径, 移入回收站 (red). Entry is Markdown note00-Inbox/示例记录.md, notfavorite, favoriteBusyfalse. Do not add folder-specific new/import rows, download-whiteboard wording, checkboxes or a submenu. Only current note condition, no actual private file content.
C: actual account popup placed TOP-START ABOVE its small owner account-trigger cue “O  owner  ˅”, respecting desktop placement. Popup strong usernameowner and exactly3 source icon rows 账户设置(lock), 帮助与快捷键(book), 退出登录(logout/red). No teams/workspace-switcher/user email/admin role, profile editor, billing or app navigation. Username is isolated fixtureowner. Source keyboard focus/Escape/leave-save signout guards remain metadata, no immediate signout success/confirmation shown.
All menus preserve actual labels and role, no ToDoo task menus, API/protocol inputs, fake busy/error/success states, titles or OS chrome. All3 complete local surfaces with every row readable, no invented closeX or footer.
